channel.title: Reflections on Bingjie's Blog
channel.description: Recent content in Reflections on Bingjie's Blog

item.title: Cocktails: Lost in the Quiet
item.description: I bought a bar kit and tried mixing a few cocktails myself, yet somehow still prefer whisky neat. Here's a rundown of cocktail history, the IBA classics, and a few personal notes from quiet bars.

item.title: Craft Beer: Life and Leisure
item.description: I usually take 30 to 50 minutes over a glass of craft beer. Here's why stout is still my go-to, plus a rundown of the ingredients, label terms, and styles I kept looking up.

item.title: Reflections on The Temple of the Golden Pavilion: Good and Evil, Beauty and Ugliness, and Emptiness
item.description: Thoughts after reading Yukio Mishima's The Temple of the Golden Pavilion, discussing the relationship between good and evil, beauty and ugliness, emptiness and reality, through the lens of Kinkakuji's protagonist Mizoguchi's inferiority, desire, and destruction.

item.title: The Core of Intimate Relationships is Friendship
item.description: Reading notes on 'The Core of Intimate Relationships is Friendship', discussing the body, friendship, and roles within relationships, while recording personal views on the book's perspectives regarding artificial intelligence.

item.title: Miscellaneous Notes: 20241104
item.description: Documenting life on November 4, 2024, sharing discussions on PhD planning and a review of the play 'The Suspect Sherlock' at the National Centre for the Performing Arts.

item.title: Miscellaneous Notes: 20241102
item.description: Recording recent updates from early November 2024, sharing reflections on blog maintenance, living alone and renting, the thesis proposal and application stages, and thoughts on life in Beijing.

item.title: We Are Always Trapped in Our Own Cognition
item.description: Starting from a discussion on Python parallelization tools, reflecting on how existing knowledge and tool habits influence choices, as well as the motivation and cognitive boundaries people face when attempting new things.

item.title: Will AI Replace Artists' Jobs?
item.description: Combining the development of diffusion models and AI art, this article discusses which tasks in artistic creation might be automated, along with the capabilities, limitations, and the creator's technical role in image generation.

item.title: A Brief Look at the Open-Source Environment in China
item.description: Discussing the domestic open-source environment from the perspective of individual developers and users, sharing views on the meaning of open source, project quality, community platforms, and participation experiences.

item.title: Recent Reflections - 20220706
item.description: Recording thoughts on life after graduation in 2022, discussing confusion and reflection regarding friendships, future choices, knowledge organization, family dynamics, and project practice.

item.title: Choosing Schedule Management Software and Reflections on Personal Workflows
item.description: Reflecting on experiences with tools like Notes, TickTick, Sticky Notes, and Feishu, discussing recurring tasks, cross-device operations, and personal workflow needs.

item.title: What Will the Next Generation of CAPTCHA Look Like? A History of CAPTCHA and the Human-Machine Arms Race
item.description: Reviewing the evolution of CAPTCHA from character recognition to image recognition, discussing human-machine confrontation, user experience, and potential directions for the next generation of CAPTCHA in the context of hCaptcha practices.

item.title: First Experience with Bigverse
item.description: Documenting my first-time experience using the Bigverse digital art platform, sharing my pixel art creation process and personal impressions of the website interface and NFT minting workflow.

item.title: The Essence of the World is Mathematics
item.description: Starting from optimizing books and re-deriving SGD, this records reflections on mathematics, matrix calculus, and learning methods, along with daily observations on campus.
